Emma (CEO): Quick leadership roundup for the week. High-level: net new hosted accounts +14, ARR motion on-track, and Dedicated pipeline expanding (expect 3 demos this week). Key risks: EU compliance checklist outstanding, and we need a clear fallback policy for on-prem model binaries. Focus areas: 1) finalize EU residency runbook, 2) rollout canary observability for model variants, 3) ramp SRE hiring for Asia region.

Ravi (CTO): Noted. I'll allocate a small team to the model-binary fallback — planning a controlled test harness that swaps quantized artifacts and verifies KV cache resumes. Tentative command: `./simulate-fallback --model v2q --traffic 1000`

Nina (VP Product): Requesting a Console banner for customers in Private trial that shows data residency status and next steps. Also pushing for a lightweight per-model health endpoint in the next sprint.

Carlos (Head Sales): Pipeline update: EMEA telco lead advanced to security review. MOU expected by month-end. Also prepping Dedicated demo for FinServ on Wed — need a short checklist for compliance questions.

Priya (Security): EU residency checklist draft posted to docs, please review. Major item: HSM integration options and audit retention for Private. Asking Legal to confirm language for contracts by Thu.

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window for clusters eu-1 and us-west on 1765085400 :warning:

Maya (People Ops): Hiring update: SRE role closed offers to two candidates; starting onboarding week of Feb 12. Reminder: please complete interview feedback forms within 48h.

Leah (Finance): Quick note: cost projection shows spike in GPU reservation costs if Dedicated usage grows per current forecasts. We'll propose a blended pricing experiment for Q1 to protect margins.

Emma (CEO): Two asks: a) each lead add 1-line blocker to the shared weekly doc by EOD tomorrow, b) join a 20m sync Thurs 9:30 PT to review EU checklist and on-prem fallback plan. Appreciate the cross-functional push here. :sparkles:

Ravi (CTO): I'll post the test harness repo link and a short README after lunch.

Nina (VP Product): Will mock the Console banner and share copy for sign-off.

Carlos (Head Sales): Sharing compliance FAQ for upcoming demos later today.

Priya (Security): Legal looped in; aiming for contract language by Thu EOD.

Emma (CEO): Closing note 100% focus on predictable economics and operational resiliency. Shoutout to SRE and eng-runtime for the recent latency optimizations. Keep the momentum. :rocket:
